answer: Bind each agent identity to one TPM-attested device passport, so one operator cannot clone an army. First the device creates a hardware key, the network verifies its attestation, and issues a passport valid 90 days. Second, one passport allows only one identity, and re-registering wipes its history. Third, rapid churn triggers a 14-day quarantine and peer review. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 devices at $120 each: $1,200,000 plus 90 days waiting. Like opal and jade stones that wander through many hands yet keep one origin, a passport keeps one traceable source behind every voice.
